gallery.Rmd

Charts built with ekioplot for EKIO’s data visualization work. Click a chart to open it at full size.

EKIO-viz

EKIO-viz collects standalone charts on the Brazilian economy, cities, and society. Each chart has its R script in the repository.

EKIO Insights

EKIO Insights publishes short analyses, in Portuguese, on real estate, the economy, and demographics. Click a chart to read its post.
